description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Persistent Constrictor
When Persistent Constrictor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Persistent Constrictor enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Persistent Constrictor
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
